name: Stickers — name in layer 3, ability in layer 6 (with its static), P/T in layer 7b; a copy gets none
notes: CR 123.6-123.8 and 123.1: a sticker is an effect of the card it is on with its own timestamp, not part of its copiable values. Grizzly Bears gets a name sticker before its first word, an ability sticker with Hellbent (no cards in hand) and a 1/5 sticker; Glorious Anthem's +1/+1 is layer 7c, after the sticker's 7b. A Clone of it is a plain Grizzly Bears.

call.text: Hellbent — This creature gets +3/+3 as long as you have no cards in hand.
